answer: One concrete sybil check is to grow standing the way a vine climbs: each new identity starts bare and only lengthens when older, already-weighted peers keep witnessing its work across epochs. That shared history is the economic anchor, because a wallet cloned overnight has no roots to borrow. When a gale of lookalike accounts shows up, settlement stays delayed and vesting keeps moving, so the fakes burn fees without ever catching the payout curve that a single persistent agent can ride.
